FN-FK439C5-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 270
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/02/2025
Senate Bill 270 as introduced would reduce the sales and use tax receipts to the various
counties which contain city school systems, by restricting the levy of county sales and use taxes
that are distributed to the county board of education for capital projects only to those areas of the
county that are served by the county board of education. Additionally, this bill would render any
county sales and use tax described in this bill void if the provisions of the bill are rendered
invalid.

FN-FK439C5-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 270
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/08/2025
Senate Bill 270 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government would
reduce sales and use tax receipts to the various counties containing city school systems,
excluding a Class 1 municipality, by restricting the levy of county sales and use taxes enacted
before January 1, 1985 in any county that does not contain a Class I municipality and was
enacted before January 1, 1985, and that are distributed to the county board of education for
capital projects, to only those areas of the county that are served by the county board of
education. This bill would render any county sales and use tax described in this bill void if the
provisions of the bill are rendered invalid.
In addition, this bill would, beginning January 1, 2026, further decrease county sales and use
taxes receipts to certain counties containing city school systems by requiring proceeds from any
county sales and use tax authorized by a local law to be distributed to every local board of
education in the county on a pro rata basis.
